import sys

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    inner = False
    length = 0
    max_length = 0
    count_underscores = 0

    for c in s:
        if c == '_':
            if inner:
                if length > 0:
                    count_underscores += 1
            else:
                max_length = max(max_length, length)
            length = 0
        elif c == '(':
            if inner:
                if length > 0:
                    count_underscores += 1
            else:
                max_length = max(max_length, length)
            inner = True
            length = 0
        elif c == ')':
            if inner:
                if length > 0:
                    count_underscores += 1
            else:
                max_length = max(max_length, length)
            inner = False
            length = 0
        else:
            length += 1

    # After loop ends, check last segment
    if inner:
        if length > 0:
            count_underscores += 1
    else:
        max_length = max(max_length, length)

    print(f"{max_length} {count_underscores}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
